title: Private Search Engines Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy
metaDescription: Calculate your search privacy risk from whether your search engine keeps your searches, whether you're signed in, and how you search.
description: Assess your current search engine's privacy risks and discover how much personal data you might be exposing. Get personalized recommendations for switching to private alternatives like DuckDuckGo or Startpage.

formula: const historyRisk = { profile: 85, kept: 50, 'not-kept': 10, unsure: 70 }; const baseRisk = historyRisk[inputs.engineHistory] ?? 70; const searchMultiplier = Math.min(inputs.dailySearches / 20, 2); const loginPenalty = inputs.loggedIn && ['profile', 'kept', 'unsure'].includes(inputs.engineHistory) ? 15: 0; const typeMultiplier = { general: 0.8, mixed: 1.0, personal: 1.3, professional: 0.9 }[inputs.searchTypes]; const incognitoBonus = { never: 0, rarely: -5, sometimes: -10, often: -20, always: -30 }[inputs.incognitoUsage]; const adBlockBonus = inputs.adBlocker ? -15: 0; const riskScore = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (baseRisk + loginPenalty + incognitoBonus + adBlockBonus) * searchMultiplier * typeMultiplier))); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High': riskScore >= 40 ? 'Medium': riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low': 'Minimal'; const dataPoints = Math.round(inputs.dailySearches * 365 * (riskScore / 100) * 3); return { riskScore, riskLevel, dataPoints };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your search privacy risk based on whether your search engine keeps your searches, how often you search, whether you're signed in, and the protective measures you use. An engine that doesn't keep searches tied to you lowers the risk the most.
tips: Use a search engine that doesn't keep your searches tied to you, such as DuckDuckGo or Startpage
If you stay signed in to your search engine, turn off search history and ad personalization, or set history to auto-delete
Sign out of Google/Microsoft accounts when searching to reduce profile building
Use private browsing mode for sensitive searches, even with private search engines
Consider different search engines for different purposes - DuckDuckGo for privacy, Google for local businesses

interpretation.label: Minimal Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices. You're using private search engines and protective measures effectively.

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices with room for minor improvements. Consider switching to private search engines.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate privacy exposure. A search engine that doesn't keep your searches would lower this the most.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure. Your searches are being tracked and profiled. Consider immediate switch to private alternatives.
